title: Penguin eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#5a6db5'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#2c3568'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- penguin body -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='62' rx='26' ry='31' fill='#3b4682'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='68' rx='17' ry='22' fill='#eef1fb'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='48' cy='33' r='17' fill='#3b4682'/>
  <!-- white face patch -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='37' rx='12' ry='11' fill='#eef1fb'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='31' r='3' fill='#101840'/>
  <circle cx='53' cy='31' r='3' fill='#101840'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='30' r='1' fill='#a8b6f0'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='30' r='1' fill='#a8b6f0'/>
  <!-- beak -->
  <path d='M44 39 L48 46 L52 39 Z' fill='#f7a53b'/>
  <path d='M44 39 L52 39 L48 42 Z' fill='#ffc46b'/>
  <!-- flippers -->
  <ellipse cx='20' cy='63' rx='6' ry='16' fill='#4a57a0' transform='rotate(12 20 63)'/>
  <ellipse cx='76' cy='63' rx='6' ry='16' fill='#4a57a0' transform='rotate(-12 76 63)'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='92' rx='9' ry='4.5' fill='#f7a53b'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='92' rx='9' ry='4.5' fill='#f7a53b'/>
  <!-- fish snack being eaten -->
  <g transform='rotate(-18 60 44)'>
    <ellipse cx='60' cy='44' rx='10' ry='5' fill='#59c4e8'/>
    <path d='M70 44 L78 38 L78 50 Z' fill='#3fa8cf'/>
    <path d='M53 44 L49 41 L49 47 Z' fill='#8adcf5'/>
    <circle cx='56' cy='43' r='1.4' fill='#101840'/>
  </g>
  <!-- sparkle -->
  <path d='M30 20 L32 25 L37 27 L32 29 L30 34 L28 29 L23 27 L28 25 Z' fill='#ffe0a3'/>
</svg>
